hook.line: A Canadian team spent 18 years computing until, in 2007, they proved that perfect play is a draw — one of the largest games ever solved.
hook.say: Let’s jump into the history of checkers!

ch.say: It was born when two games merged.
p: Around the 12th century in France, alquerque pieces are said to have been moved onto a chessboard.
By the 16th century the “you must capture” rule took hold, and the game split into British, Dutch, Russian and other rule sets.
st: Alquerque pieces move onto the chessboard

ch.say: If you can capture, you must!
p: Pieces move one square diagonally forward and capture by jumping.
Reach the far row and you are crowned a king that can also move backward.
